findings.title: Deep learning-based pairs trading: real-time forecasting of co-integrated crypto pairs
findings.note: Crypto focus; Johansen + deep learning for spread dynamics. Not directly applicable to our equity pairs (EXHAUSTED family). Filed for awareness.

findings.title: Novel Graphical Matching Approach to Pairs Trading
findings.note: Already in our wiki (H200 was based on this). Cointegration still fails in large-cap equities. Pairs family remains EXHAUSTED.

findings.title: Enhancing Post Earnings Announcement Drift Measurement with Large Language Models (SUE.txt)
findings.note: SUE.txt (text-derived surprise) outperforms numeric SUE. Direct H174 upgrade candidate.

findings.title: Hybrid FinBERT-LSTM for Earnings Call Transcripts
findings.note: FinBERT + LSTM on transcripts. Supports H174 upgrade direction but requires transcript data (no free API ready). Track for when transcript data available.

findings.title: Dynamic FinBERT Sentiment as 6th Factor in FF5
findings.note: Sentiment as factor augmentation. Interesting for H202-XL feature engineering but not immediately actionable.

findings.title: Cross-sectional factor momentum: evidence from multiple formation periods
findings.note: Post-publication validation of multi-window momentum. Queued H218 (3-1m/6-1m/9-3m/12-1m sensitivity scan).

findings.title: Scaling Conditional Autoencoders via Uncertainty-Aware Factor Selection
findings.note: Attention-based factor interaction learning. Relevant to H202-XL feature engineering but requires significant ML infrastructure. Deferred to H202-XL session.

findings.title: BlindTrade: Anonymization-First LLM Portfolio (arXiv:2603.17692)
findings.note: Sharpe 1.40 on 2025 data. Anonymization methodology is prerequisite for H209/H210 validity testing.

findings.title: TrustTrade: Selective Consensus for LLM Agents (arXiv:2603.22567)
findings.note: Folded into BlindTrade wiki update (staged as companion methodology). Both address LLM trading reliability.

findings.title: LLM-Transformer Hybrid Nowcasting (arXiv:2601.02878)
findings.note: Text + price series fusion. Relevant to H210 LLM nowcasting but requires H202-XL first.

findings.title: TradingAgents v0.2.4 — LangGraph Multi-Agent Framework
findings.note: Open-source reference for H209. Lower Sharpe (23-27% cumul) than confirmed strategies but useful architecture reference.

findings.title: FinRL-X: AI-Native Modular Trading Infrastructure
findings.note: Modern alternative to yfinance+Vectorbt. 7 asset classes, native ML. Worth evaluating when scaling to H202-XL 200-stock universe. Not staging now — current stack is working.

findings.title: cloudQuant/backtrader — 45% faster
findings.note: Speed improvement but not transformative vs our vectorized Pandas approach.

wiki_expansion.rationale: PEAD is our strongest live strategy; no dedicated earnings calendar data source page existed. Covers FMP, Finnhub, yfinance, API Ninjas, EDGAR/EdgarTools, EPS surprise formulas, recommended hybrid stack for pead_overnight.py upgrade.

summary: Strongest signals this session: (1) SUE.txt paper from ACL FinnLP 2025 — direct PEAD signal upgrade; (2) BlindTrade arXiv:2603.17692 — Sharpe 1.40 LLM portfolio with anonymization validation methodology, directly relevant to H209; (3) Factor momentum multi-window paper — post-publication validated, queued H218; (4) Internal: H217 median alpha101 from tonight's H215 sensitivity showing OOS 1.559.
